tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi sngon gyi skyes rabs rnams chos skyong yid bzhin nor bus gsung shog du phul ba'i don 'grel skal bzang kun gyi yid 'phrog ces bya ba bzhugs// oṃ swa sti sid+dhi/ bdag cag lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba kun gyi 'dren pa dam pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs pad dam pa'i drung du/ yongs su grags pa ltar na bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi srung ma gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po tse'u dmar po zhes grags shing / gnod sbyin nyid la bcom ldan 'das kyis rta mgrin gyi sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur nas gnod sbyin rgyal po spu gri dmar po'i snying gi rgyud gsungs pa'i rjes su slar yang slob dpon pad+mas dbang bskur mdzad dus kyi gsang mtshan ltar na chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal zhes bya ba chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu 'di nyid kyis thog mar rta mgrin gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang nos tshul/ de'i rjes su slob dpon pad+mas gsang mtshan btags tshul/ rgyud gter nas bton tshul sogs kyi lo rgyus rnams gnod sbyin rgyal po spu gri dmar po'i snying gi rgyud kyi dpe rnying bsam yas rang nas byung ba'i yid ches can gyi nang na gsal bar bzhugs so/ /de nyid kyis/ chu phag hor zla bdun pa'i nyer bdun gyi nyin dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi sde brgyad 'du ba'i lha'i pho brang nas sngags 'chang chen po 'di nyid kyi sngon gyi 'khrungs rabs rags rim zhu 'phrin du phul ba las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ ༈ /sa dkar po'i yul na rig 'dzin brgyud pa spel ba'i rig 'dzin pho brang dam pa der/ rgya nag po'i yul gyi rtse lnga nas/ /smra ba'i seng ge ming du btags/

/'ja' tshugs su ldan pa'i rta pho de la bzhon/ /gu ru pad+ma'i dus zhi ba mtsho dang bstun/ /mkhas pa shrī singha'i ming tu btags/ /bkod pa yar la gcig byas na ston pa shākya'i dus/ mau 'gal gyi bu/ rim par brgyud pa'i gnam ri srong btsan/ de la gces pa mgar ba'i ming / nye bar brgyud pa'i chos ni dar ba'i dus/ /sgra sgyur rnams kyi gral la 'khod/ /bar ma do yi 'ga' shas su/ /rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du sprul pa byung / /rgya gar yul nas tshur la log bod yul sa dkar kun dga'i ming can de la zlo ba/ zhes 'byung ba de dag gi don chos skyong chen pos mkhan tshangs par lhug stsol du phebs 'dug pa dang mthun par cung zad tsam tshigs su bcad pa'i sgo nas bkrol ba 'di lta ste/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga'i pho brang nas/ /sangs rgyas gsung gi gsang ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /smra ba'i seng ge gang de don dam par/ /zab mo chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /sems can don du kun rdzob gdul bya'i ngor/ /ston mchog dam pa shākya'i rgyal po nyid/ /rigs can gsum la chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus/ /nyan thos rdzu 'phrul can gyi mchog gyur pa/ /mau 'gal gyi bu zhes bya bar sprul/ /'di yi rnam thar mdo sde rnams las 'byung / /slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /mkhas pa chen po zhi ba 'tsho yi dus/ /u rgyan nyid dang bai ro tsa na sogs/ /mkhas grub kun la man ngag stsol mdzad pa'i/ /paṇa chen shrī singha zhes byar sprul/ /'di yi rnam thar thang yig 'ga' las 'byung / /bod yul chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus/ /rgya bal rten gsum chos 'khor lha sa'i jo shāka rnam gnyis sogs/ rin chen spyan drangs sogs/ /bod yul bde skyid 'byung ba'i byed po mchog /blon po mgar ba stong btsan zhes byar sprul/ /de yi mdzad pa rgyal rabs rnams las gsal/ /de nas bod 'dir bstan pa dar ba'i tshe/ /sgra sgyur lo tsā rtsod bral du mar sprul/

/de nas ha cang mi ring bar gyi char/ /rgya gar yul gyi skyes chen du ma ru/ /sprul nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i don mang mdzad/ /slar yang bod yul mun pa'i smag rum 'dir/ /sngags 'chang chos rjes bstan pa'i me ro nyid/ /legs par gsos pa 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phyir/ /bod yul rdo rje gdan gyi chos grwa 'dir/ /lha rigs 'khon gyi gdung 'dzin sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun bsod grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po'i mtshan can nyid du legs sprul pa/ /yin zhes dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa yi/ /'phrin las mgon pos rab tu bsngags pa 'di/ /kun las khyad par 'phags pa'i rnam thar yin/ /des na shākya'i dus na mau 'gal bu/ /pad+ma'i dus na shrī singha'i mtshan/ /srong btsan sgam po'i dus na blon po mgar/ /da lta ngag dbang kun dga'i mtshan can yin/ /thos bsam sgom pas lung rtogs yon tan brnyes/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas bstan pa zla ltar spel/ /'dzin skyong spel bas thub pa'i rgyal sa 'dzin/ /mgon 'di'i mdzad pa byis blo'i yul las 'das/ /de skad smra ba dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /brgyud par bcas la snying nas dad thob pa'i/ /rmad byung rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin chen gyi/ /rgyal mtshan 'dzin par 'dod pa gang de'o/ /'di sbyar dge bas bstan 'dzin sku tshe brtan/ /dge 'dun sde 'phel bstan pa rab rgyas nas/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /bshad sgrub 'phrin las rgyun mi chad par bsngo// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ sngon gyi skyes rabs rnams chos skyong yid bzhin nor bus gsung shog du phul ba'i don 'grel/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
